commands.name: ChangeEnemyEquipment
commands.label: Change Enemy Equipment
commands.summary: Puts a weapon or armor into one equipment slot of one enemy in the current troop, or empties the slot.

args.name: enemyIndex
args.meaning: Which troop member, counted from 0.

args.name: slotIndex
args.meaning: Which equipment slot, counted from 0.

args.name: kind
args.meaning: 2 for a weapon, 3 for an armor.

args.name: itemId
args.meaning: The weapon or armor's database number; 0 empties the slot.

commands.name: GetOnVehicle
commands.label: Get On Reactor Vehicle
commands.summary: Puts the party on a vehicle, walking aboard or at once.

args.name: vehicle
args.meaning: Which vehicle: left out or "this" is the event running the command; also "nearest", "ridden", "boat", "ship" or "airship" (the stock ones), an event number on this map, or a vehicle's identity such as "0:3".

args.name: instant
args.meaning: Boards at once with no walk; false when left out.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until boarding is done; true when left out.

commands.name: GetOffVehicle
commands.label: Get Off Reactor Vehicle
commands.summary: Takes the party off the vehicle it is riding.

args.name: instant
args.meaning: Gets off at once with no walk; false when left out.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until the party is off; true when left out.

commands.name: PlayModelAnimation
commands.label: Play Model Animation
commands.summary: Plays a named animation on a character's 3D model; several in a row queue up and play one after another.

args.name: target
args.meaning: Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number (a placed prop is 10000 + its prop number).

args.name: animation
args.meaning: The animation's name from the model; empty stops the animation and clears the queue.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until that animation has played once through (at most 1800 frames); the player can still walk meanwhile.

commands.name: SetModelAnimationSpeed
commands.label: Set Model Animation Speed
commands.summary: Changes how fast a character's 3D model animates.

args.name: target
args.meaning: Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number.

args.name: speed
args.meaning: Speed in percent, 1 to 1000; 100 when left out or not a number.

commands.name: PlayModelEffect
commands.label: Play 3D Effect
commands.summary: Plays one of a 3D model's own effects at the spot it was placed on the model.

args.name: target
args.meaning: Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number.

args.name: effect
args.meaning: The effect's name from the model's effects list; empty does nothing.

commands.name: SpeakModel3D
commands.label: Speak 3D Dialogue
commands.summary: Plays a voice clip from a 3D character and moves its mouth with the sound, or stops that voice.

args.name: operation
args.meaning: "stop" stops the character's voice; anything else speaks.

args.name: target
args.meaning: Who speaks: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number.

args.name: audio
args.meaning: The sound file in audio/se, without its extension.

args.name: volume
args.meaning: Volume, 90 when left out.

args.name: pitch
args.meaning: Pitch, 100 when left out.

args.name: pan
args.meaning: Left-right pan, 0 when left out.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until the voice finishes; true unless "false".

commands.name: ChangeCamera3D
commands.label: Change 3D Camera
commands.summary: Moves the 3D map camera to another view, eased over a number of frames.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: The camera mode; some other spellings are accepted, and an unknown one is fixed.

args.name: pitch
args.meaning: Tilt in degrees, -89 to 89; blank uses the mode's own.

args.name: yaw
args.meaning: Turn in degrees, -360 to 360; blank uses the mode's own.

args.name: distance
args.meaning: Distance from what it looks at, in tiles, 0.5 to 1024; blank uses the mode's own.

args.name: fov
args.meaning: Field of view in degrees, 5 to 150; blank uses the mode's own.

args.name: focus
args.meaning: What the camera centres on; anything else is auto (the mode's own choice).

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: For focus event: the event to follow; 0 is this event.

args.name: duration
args.meaning: Frames to ease over, 0 to 6000; 0 is at once.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until the camera has arrived (only when duration is above 0).

args.name: keep
args.meaning: Keeps this camera on later maps instead of each map's own.

commands.name: TransformModel3D
commands.label: Transform 3D Model
commands.summary: Moves, turns and scales a character's 3D model from its placed pose, eased over a number of frames.

args.name: target
args.meaning: Whose model: 0 this event, -1 the player, -2 and below the followers, or an event number (a placed prop is 10000 + its prop number).

args.name: offsetX
args.meaning: Shift left-right in tiles; 0 when left out.

args.name: offsetY
args.meaning: Shift along the map's depth (toward or away from the bottom of the map) in tiles; 0 when left out.

args.name: offsetZ
args.meaning: Shift up or down in tiles; 0 when left out.

args.name: yaw
args.meaning: Turn in degrees; 0 when left out.

args.name: pitch
args.meaning: Tilt forward or back in degrees; 0 when left out.

args.name: roll
args.meaning: Roll sideways in degrees; 0 when left out.

args.name: scaleX
args.meaning: Width scale; 1 when left out or not above 0.

args.name: scaleY
args.meaning: Height scale; 1 when left out or not above 0.

args.name: scaleZ
args.meaning: Depth scale; 1 when left out or not above 0.

args.name: duration
args.meaning: Frames to ease over; 0 is at once.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event for the duration.

commands.name: LightSwitch
commands.label: Switch Light
commands.summary: Turns a map light, or every light with a tag, on, off, or the other way.

args.name: target
args.meaning: A light's id, or "#tag" for every light with that tag.

args.name: state
args.meaning: "off" turns it off, "toggle" flips it, anything else turns it on.

commands.name: TransformLight
commands.label: Transform Light
commands.summary: Eases a map light, or every light with a tag, to new position, direction, size, brightness or color.

args.name: target
args.meaning: A light's id, or "#tag" for every light with that tag.

args.name: x
args.meaning: Position across in tiles (an offset when the light rides a character); blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: y
args.meaning: Position down the map in tiles (an offset when the light rides a character); blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: height
args.meaning: Height in tiles; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: yaw
args.meaning: Direction it points, in degrees; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: pitch
args.meaning: Tilt in degrees; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: radius
args.meaning: Reach in tiles; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: angle
args.meaning: Cone angle in degrees, for a spotlight; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: width
args.meaning: Beam width in tiles; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: intensity
args.meaning: Brightness; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: color
args.meaning: Color as "#rrggbb"; blank leaves it as placed.

args.name: duration
args.meaning: Frames to ease over; 0 is at once.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event for the duration.

args.name: reset
args.meaning: Drops what earlier commands set on this target, back to the light as placed; the other fields are then ignored.

commands.name: AmbientLight
commands.label: Change Ambient Light
commands.summary: Eases the map's overall ambient light to a new brightness and color.

args.name: intensity
args.meaning: Brightness from 0 to 1; blank leaves it as it is.

args.name: color
args.meaning: Color as "#rrggbb"; blank leaves it as it is.

args.name: duration
args.meaning: Frames to ease over; 0 is at once.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event for the duration.

args.name: reset
args.meaning: Goes back to the map's own ambient light at once; the other fields are then ignored.

commands.name: ScopedWait
commands.label: Scoped Wait
commands.summary: Holds the event until something happens while the player keeps moving: a character's actions finish, time passes, a switch flips or a variable reaches a value.

args.name: target
args.meaning: Whose actions to wait on: "all" (the default when left out), 0 this event, -1 the player, or an event number; only used by the actions mode.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: What ends the wait; anything else is actions (model animations and, for one character, a forced move route; at most 3600 frames).

args.name: duration
args.meaning: For duration: frames to wait; 0 when left out.

args.name: switchId
args.meaning: For switch: the switch to watch; 1 when left out.

args.name: switchValue
args.meaning: For switch: "false" waits for OFF, anything else for ON.

args.name: variableId
args.meaning: For variable: the variable to watch; 1 when left out.

args.name: op
args.meaning: For variable: how it is compared with value; anything else is >=.

args.name: value
args.meaning: For variable: the number compared against; 0 when left out.

args.name: resume
args.meaning: Lets the waiting event carry on with its own movement while it waits; true unless "false".

commands.name: QuestSet
commands.label: Quest
commands.summary: Discovers, completes, fails, resets, tracks or stops tracking a quest.

args.name: questId
args.meaning: The quest's number or key (the older name "quest" is read too).

args.name: action
args.type: discover | complete | fail | reset | track | untrack
args.meaning: What to do; discover when left out. track also discovers it; untrack only stops tracking if it is the tracked quest.

commands.name: QuestObjective
commands.label: Quest Objective
commands.summary: Shows, hides, completes, fails or reopens one objective of a quest, or all of them.

args.name: questId
args.meaning: The quest's number or key (the older name "quest" is read too).

args.name: objective
args.meaning: The objective's number counted from 1, or "all" (also when left out).

args.name: state
args.meaning: What to set it to; complete when left out. reset opens it again.

commands.name: QuestReward
commands.label: Quest Reward
commands.summary: Shows or hides a quest's reward in the log, or gives it to the party.

args.name: questId
args.meaning: The quest's number or key (the older name "quest" is read too).

args.name: reward
args.meaning: The reward's number counted from 1, or "all" (also when left out).

args.name: state
args.meaning: "give" hands it over once, "hide" hides it, anything else shows it; show when left out.

commands.name: OpenQuestLog
commands.label: Open Quest Log
commands.summary: Opens the quest log screen.

args.name: questId
args.meaning: A quest's number or key to open the log on; left out, the log opens as usual. Not used when the log is VisuStella's.

commands.name: SteamAchievement
commands.label: Steam Achievement
commands.summary: Unlocks a Steam achievement, or locks it again for testing.

args.name: api
args.meaning: The achievement's API name from Steamworks (letters, digits, _ . -).

args.name: action
args.meaning: "clear" locks it again; anything else unlocks; unlock when left out.

commands.name: CharacterCreation
commands.label: Character Creation
commands.summary: Opens the character creation screen, or the character choice screen, as the game is set up.

args.name: once
args.meaning: Skips the screen when the player already has a character; any value given counts as on, so leave it out for off.

args.name: required
args.meaning: The player must finish, with no way back; any value given counts as on, so leave it out for off.

args.name: switchId
args.meaning: A switch turned ON when the player has their character and OFF when they backed out; 0 for none.

commands.name: CallUserInterface
commands.label: Call User Interface
commands.summary: Opens one of the game's custom user interface screens; does nothing in battle.

args.name: interfaceId
args.meaning: The interface's number from the User Interface editor; 0 does nothing.

commands.name: ChangeFollowerFormation
commands.label: Change Follower Formation
commands.summary: Changes how the followers walk behind the leader, kept with the save.

args.name: formation
args.type: file | loose | rank | wedge | column | scattered
args.meaning: The shape; any other value goes back to the game's own formation.

args.name: spacing
args.meaning: Tiles between members, 1 to 4.

args.name: straggle
args.meaning: How late and unevenly they follow, 0 to 100.

commands.name: FollowerOrders
commands.label: Follower Orders
commands.summary: Tells followers to follow, stay, walk to a tile, come back to the leader, hide or show.

args.name: who
args.meaning: "follower" is one place in the line, "actor" the follower who is that actor, anything else every follower.

args.name: index
args.meaning: For follower: the place in the line, counted from 1.

args.name: actorId
args.meaning: For actor: the actor's database number.

args.name: order
args.type: follow | stay | goto | come | hide | show
args.meaning: The order; follow when left out.

args.name: x
args.meaning: For goto: the tile's x.

args.name: y
args.meaning: For goto: the tile's y.

args.name: direction
args.meaning: For goto: the way to face on arrival (2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 8 up); anything else keeps its facing.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: For goto and come: holds the event until they arrive.

commands.name: StartMapBattle
commands.label: Start Battle on Map
commands.summary: Starts a battle right on the map with the units there, or the ordinary battle screen when the mode in force is Classic.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: The battle mode; any other value (or none) uses the mode in force: the next-battle setting, the troop's, this map's, then the game's.

args.name: who
args.meaning: "near" takes the units near the party that the start rule takes; anything else takes every unit on the map.

args.name: troopId
args.meaning: A troop whose members join the battle, placed round the party; 0 for none. Classic mode fights this troop on the battle screen.

args.name: turns
args.meaning: How turns go; any other value uses the game's setting.

args.name: objective
args.meaning: What wins the battle; anything else is defeatAll.

args.name: turnsToSurvive
args.meaning: For survive: the turns to last (at least 1).

args.name: unitEventId
args.meaning: For defeatUnit: the event number of the unit to beat.

args.name: goalSwitchId
args.meaning: For switch: the battle is won when this switch is ON.

args.name: goalVariableId
args.meaning: For variable: the variable that is checked.

args.name: goalValue
args.meaning: For variable: the battle is won when the variable is at least this value.

args.name: onTransfer
args.meaning: What happens if the party leaves the map mid-battle: "keep" keeps the battle, anything else counts as an escape.

args.name: view
args.meaning: "map" keeps the map's own camera on a 3D map; any other value uses the battle's own view; left out, the game's setting decides.

args.name: canEscape
args.meaning: Whether the party may run away.

args.name: canLose
args.meaning: Whether the game goes on after a loss instead of ending.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until the battle ends, then takes the If Win / If Escape / If Lose branch.

args.name: resultVariable
args.meaning: A variable that gets the result (0 win, 1 escape, 2 lose); 0 for none.

commands.name: SpawnUnit
commands.label: Spawn Unit
commands.summary: Puts a new actor or enemy unit on the map, which joins a battle that is running.

args.name: record
args.meaning: The kind of database record; anything else is enemy.

args.name: id
args.meaning: The actor's or enemy's database number.

args.name: team
args.meaning: Its side; left out, ally for an actor and enemy for an enemy. Any other value spawns nothing.

args.name: at
args.meaning: "event" places it on a free spot next to a character, "variables" reads the tile from two variables, anything else uses x and y as the tile.

args.name: x
args.meaning: The tile's x, or with at = variables the variable holding it.

args.name: y
args.meaning: The tile's y, or with at = variables the variable holding it.

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: For at = event: the character to stand next to (0 this event, -1 the player, or an event number).

args.name: height
args.meaning: On a tile with several floors, which floor (a height); left out, the ground.

args.name: direction
args.meaning: The way it faces: 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, 8 up; 0 or left out keeps the default.

args.name: template
args.meaning: An event on this map whose pages the unit copies; 0 for none.

commands.name: ChangeUnitSide
commands.label: Change Unit Side
commands.summary: Moves a unit to another side, in a battle running now and in later battles on this map.

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: The unit's event number; 0 is this event.

args.name: team
args.meaning: The new side; any other value (or none) gives the unit back its own side from its event.

commands.name: RemoveUnit
commands.label: Remove Unit
commands.summary: Takes a unit out of the battle on the map.

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: The unit's event number; 0 is this event.

args.name: keep
args.meaning: Leaves the event standing on the map instead of erasing it.

commands.name: EndMapBattle
commands.label: End Battle on Map
commands.summary: Ends the battle on the map with the result given.

args.name: result
args.meaning: How it ends; anything else is win.

commands.name: ChangeBattleGoal
commands.label: Change Battle Goal
commands.summary: Changes what wins the battle that is running on the map, checked at once.

args.name: objective
args.meaning: What wins the battle; anything else is defeatAll.

args.name: turnsToSurvive
args.meaning: For survive: the turns to last (at least 1).

args.name: unitEventId
args.meaning: For defeatUnit: the event number of the unit to beat; it joins the battle if it is not in it.

args.name: goalSwitchId
args.meaning: For switch: the battle is won when this switch is ON.

args.name: goalVariableId
args.meaning: For variable: the variable that is checked.

args.name: goalValue
args.meaning: For variable: the battle is won when the variable is at least this value.

commands.name: ChangeBattleMode
commands.label: Change Battle Mode
commands.summary: Sets which kind of battle the game, this map, or only the next battle uses.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: The battle mode; "default" or any other value clears the setting for that scope.

args.name: scope
args.meaning: Where it applies: "map" this map, "next" the next battle only, anything else the whole game.

commands.name: SetTerrainCost
commands.label: Set Terrain Cost
commands.summary: Sets how many steps it costs to move onto a region or terrain tag in tactical battles from now on.

args.name: type
args.meaning: "terrain" means a terrain tag; anything else a region.

args.name: id
args.meaning: The region (1 and up) or terrain tag (0 and up).

args.name: cost
args.meaning: Steps it costs, up to 20; 0 blocks it, 1 or a non-number is the ordinary step.

commands.name: ShowVideoSurface
commands.label: Show Media Surface
commands.summary: Shows a video or picture as a flat surface on the map, on a character, or on the screen; a new surface with the same number replaces the old one.

args.name: id
args.meaning: The surface's number, 1 to 999999 (also read as surfaceId or videoId); required.

args.name: movie
args.meaning: The file (also read as file or filename): a .webm or .mp4 in movies/, or a .png, .jpg, .webp or .jxl in img/pictures/; required.

args.name: target
args.meaning: What it is placed on (also read as bindTo); map when left out.

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: For target event: the event's number.

args.name: x
args.meaning: On the map the tile x; on a character an offset in pixels; on the screen the pixel x of its centre. 0 when left out.

args.name: y
args.meaning: On the map the tile y; on a character an offset in pixels; on the screen the pixel y of its centre. 0 when left out.

args.name: z
args.meaning: Height above the ground in tiles, on 3D maps only; 0 when left out.

args.name: width
args.meaning: Width in pixels, 1 to 8192; 320 when left out.

args.name: height
args.meaning: Height in pixels, 1 to 8192; 180 when left out.

args.name: rotationX
args.meaning: Turn about the x axis in degrees; 0 when left out.

args.name: rotationY
args.meaning: Turn about the y axis in degrees; 0 when left out.

args.name: rotationZ
args.meaning: Turn about the z axis in degrees (also read as rotation); 0 when left out.

args.name: scaleX
args.meaning: Horizontal scale; 1 when left out.

args.name: scaleY
args.meaning: Vertical scale; 1 when left out.

args.name: opacity
args.meaning: Opacity 0 to 255 (or alpha, 0 to 1); fully opaque when left out.

args.name: loop
args.meaning: Plays the video over and over; true when left out, and turned off when wait is on.

args.name: muted
args.meaning: Plays without sound; true when left out unless audio is given.

args.name: audio
args.meaning: The opposite of muted, read when muted is left out.

args.name: volume
args.meaning: Volume 0 to 100; 100 when left out.

args.name: playbackRate
args.meaning: Playback speed, 0.05 to 16; 1 when left out.

args.name: layer
args.meaning: Drawing layer, a number or below (0), ground (1), characters (3), above (5), screen (10); 3 when left out.

args.name: depth
args.meaning: On a 3D map, moves it toward the camera in tiles; in 2D it orders surfaces within a layer. 0 when left out.

args.name: cullingDistance
args.meaning: Hides it when it is this far outside the screen (2D, pixels) or from the camera (3D); 0 never hides it.

args.name: scanlines
args.meaning: Draws TV scanlines over it: true/false, or a strength from 0 to 1; 0 when left out.

args.name: corners
args.meaning: Four {x, y} points for a bent shape instead of the width × height rectangle (also x0..y3 one by one); left out, the rectangle.

args.name: worldCorners
args.meaning: Four {x, y} points the surface is stretched to in the world; left out, not used.

args.name: wait
args.meaning: Holds the event until the video ends; ignored for a picture.

commands.name: TransformVideoSurface
commands.label: Transform Media Surface
commands.summary: Changes a media surface that is showing: only the fields given change, at once.

args.name: id
args.meaning: The number of a surface that is showing; required.

args.name: target
args.meaning: What it is placed on.

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: For target event: the event's number.

args.name: x
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: y
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: z
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: width
args.meaning: Width in pixels; also resizes its shape unless it has corners set by hand.

args.name: height
args.meaning: Height in pixels; also resizes its shape unless it has corners set by hand.

args.name: rotationX
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: rotationY
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: rotationZ
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: scaleX
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: scaleY
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: opacity
args.meaning: Opacity 0 to 255 (or alpha, 0 to 1).

args.name: loop
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: muted
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: audio
args.meaning: The opposite of muted, read when muted is left out.

args.name: volume
args.meaning: Volume 0 to 100.

args.name: playbackRate
args.meaning: Playback speed, 0.05 to 16.

args.name: layer
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: depth
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: cullingDistance
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: scanlines
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

args.name: corners
args.meaning: Four {x, y} points (also x0..y3 one by one); setting them marks the corners as set by hand.

args.name: worldCorners
args.meaning: As in Show Media Surface.

commands.name: StopVideoSurface
commands.label: Stop Media Surface
commands.summary: Removes a media surface and releases any event waiting on it.

args.name: id
args.meaning: The surface's number (also read as surfaceId or videoId).

commands.name: WaitForModelAnimation
commands.label: Scoped Wait (old name)
commands.summary: The first name of Scoped Wait, kept so events saved with it still work; it does exactly what Scoped Wait does.

args.name: target
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: duration
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: switchId
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: switchValue
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: variableId
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: op
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: value
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

args.name: resume
args.meaning: As in Scoped Wait.

commands.name: BattleRoomEvent
commands.label: Call Battle Room Event
commands.summary: In a battle fought in a Battle Room, runs the current page of one of that room's events (the Battle Presentation editor adds it to a troop page).

args.name: eventId
args.meaning: The event's number on the Battle Room's map.

commands.name: BattleSequenceSkip
commands.label: Skip Battle Sequence
commands.summary: Skips the battle action sequence that is playing, landing all its hits at once.

commands.name: BattleRoomCamera
commands.label: Battle Room Camera
commands.summary: In a battle fought in a Battle Room, moves the room's camera to a set place and angle.

args.name: x
args.meaning: Where it looks, across the room in tiles; left out keeps the current value.

args.name: y
args.meaning: Where it looks, down the room in tiles; left out keeps the current value.

args.name: z
args.meaning: Height of the point it looks at, in tiles; left out keeps the current value.

args.name: yaw
args.meaning: Turn in degrees; left out keeps the current value.

args.name: pitch
args.meaning: Tilt in degrees; left out keeps the current value.

args.name: distance
args.meaning: Distance from the point it looks at, in tiles; left out keeps the current value.

commands.name: SetVehicleLocation
commands.label: Set Reactor Vehicle Location
commands.summary: Moves a parked Reactor vehicle to a tile on this map, or takes it out of the world.

args.name: vehicle
args.meaning: Which vehicle: left out or "this" is the event running the command; also an event number on this map, a vehicle's identity such as "0:3", "nearest" or "ridden".

args.name: remove
args.meaning: Takes the vehicle out of the world instead of moving it; false when left out.

args.name: x
args.meaning: The tile's x; required to move it.

args.name: y
args.meaning: The tile's y; required to move it.

args.name: yaw
args.meaning: The way it faces, in degrees; 0 when left out.

args.name: z
args.meaning: On a tile with several floors, the height to stand on; left out, the ground.
